# Code of conduct

BucketBridge is a place for people to build and use a useful tool together.
Everyone taking part in issues, discussions and pull requests is expected to
keep it welcoming.

## Expected behaviour

- Be respectful and assume good faith.
- Give and accept feedback on the work, not the person.
- Be patient with newcomers and with different levels of experience.
- Stay on topic and keep discussions constructive.

## Unacceptable behaviour

- Harassment, insults, threats or discriminatory language.
- Personal attacks, trolling or deliberately derailing discussions.
- Publishing someone else's private information.
- Spam or advertising unrelated to the project.

## Enforcement

The maintainer, Anup Shaw (anupshaw50), is responsible for applying this code.
Comments, issues and contributions that break it may be edited, hidden or
removed, and repeat or serious offenders may be blocked from the project.

## Reporting

Contact the maintainer through the contact options on the GitHub profile
github.com/anupshaw50. For sensitive cases, open a private security advisory on
the repository and say it is a conduct report. Reports are handled in
confidence.
